stories.title: How Hannah Rapp's life and bright boxing future ended on a Texas road
stories.summary: A bright boxing future is wiped out in an encounter with Texas man with a long record of police arrests

stories.title: New York sues Kalshi alleging 'illegal gambling'
stories.summary: The state of New York filed a lawsuit against Kalshi on Friday, accusing the prediction market company of running an "illegal gambling operation."

stories.title: Skattebo admits doing 'dumb things,' but 'you learn'
stories.summary: Giants running back Cam Skattebo admitted Friday to sometimes doing "dumb things," citing his recent backflip at Fanatics Fest, and said he met with coach John Harbaugh.

stories.title: Romo placed on leave by CBS after OWI arrest
stories.summary: CBS Sports has placed NFL analyst Tony Romo on leave following his arrest last week on suspicion of driving under the influence.

stories.title: Sources: Wemby lands signature shoe in Nike deal
stories.summary: Spurs star Victor Wembanyama signed a new, long-term deal with Nike that includes a signature sneaker, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.
